problems.title: iii-sdk 0.24.4 is older than 0.26
problems.detail: The deploy would go green and the http group would serve no route.
problems.fix: Upgrade iii-sdk to 0.27.0 in the lockfile.

problems.title: Runs with bun, but the repository has only a pnpm lock
problems.detail: The cloud installs bun projects from bun.lock: nothing would be installed.
problems.fix: Run with node and keep the pnpm lock, or add a bun.lock.

problems.title: Migrations run in your CD, not in the cloud
problems.detail: .github/workflows/cd.yml runs db:migrate; it moves to cloud.release.
problems.fix: Move the db:migrate command to cloud.release in the compose file.

problems.title: No healthcheck
problems.detail: Without one, a deploy is Ready even when nothing answers.
problems.fix: Add cloud.healthcheck with a path that answers 200.

agent_problems.title: Lock missing
agent_problems.detail: The compose file has no lock beside it: api/worker-compose-prod.lock.
agent_problems.fix: Generate the lock and commit it next to the compose file.
